# Once the baseline passes, the tests run one more time, with muxt's own
# template engine in place of html/template, to learn which template
# actions they execute.
#
# The test below renders the page for a guest only, so nothing it runs
# reaches the {{.Secret}} inside {{if .Admin}}. That mutant is skipped
# rather than run, since nothing could catch it, and -v lists it under
# "no test reaches" so the gap reads as an untested branch. The summary
# counts it among the skips and as unreached. The mutants the test does
# reach are killed or missed as they would be without the pre-pass.
# --include-uncovered-nodes runs it anyway; see
# reference_test_template_mutations_include_uncovered.txt.

! muxt test-template-mutations -v --seed 1
cmp stdout want.txt
! stderr 'warning:'
! stderr 'tests fail under'

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.27
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "page"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{if .Admin}} {{.Secret}}{{end}}{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name   string
	Admin  bool
	Secret string
}

func Render(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "page", page)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGuestPage(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Render(&buf, Page{Name: "Ada", Secret: "s3cret"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Hello, Ada!"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("page = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- want.txt --
